newsitem.title: USA: International Multifoods names new CEO.
newsitem.headline: International Multifoods names new CEO.

text.p: International Multifoods Corp said it named Gary Costley to be chairman, chief executive and president effective January 1, 1997.
Costley will replace chairman and chief executive Robert Price, who will remain a board member.
Costley was previously dean of the Babcock Graduate School of Management at Wake Forest University and an executive with Kellogg Co.
Costley spent 24 years with Kellogg, including as executive vice president and area director of Kellogg North America.

"He is an experienced, results-oriented operations executive who has demonstrated strategic and ledership capabilities and unquestionable integrity," Price said. "Gary's knowledge and understanding of the food industry will benefit Multifood."
